The '''Orbital Spaceyard 301''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]]. The [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Implacable (Star Destroyer)/Legends|''Implacable'']] was berthed there shortly prior the [[Battle of Folor|battle]] of [[Folor]].<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>
